Instinct takes over, and I sprint towards the safety of my home, my mind reeling with a mix of horror and disbelief.

Breathless and trembling, I lock myself in my room, seeking solace within the confines of its walls. Fear consumes me as I huddle under the blanket, attempting to shield myself from the nightmarish reality that unfolds outside. Time seems to stretch endlessly, my senses on high alert, as I strain to catch any sign of danger. Minutes turn into an eternity, and eventually, the silence lulls me into a false sense of security. My racing heart begins to slow, and a glimmer of relief flickers within me.

But in an instant, that fragile peace is shattered.
